reviews.text: They were incredibly kind and understanding. They thoroughly prepared me for everything and took the time I needed to make sure me and my sweet dog were as comfortable as possible. I highly recommend!! There were also no extra our hidden fees, which i very much appreciated.

Dr elieen and her assistant her phenomenal in their care. Even before we we agreed to her services she spent a significant amount of time on the phone with us talking about our cat. She is highly compassionate and knowledgeable. When she came over to assess our cat named butters her energy was very calming and caring. So much so butters who was barely even able to walk mustered all his strength to walk over to her and sit right next to her. He knew she was there to help him. During the whole process and transition she remained empathetic and aware to the needs our family. Our experience with her really helped us through this difficult time and anyone who is in need of these types of services I highly recommend her.
Very professional and caring services, attention to detail, emotional support and help with the cremation of our beloved dog Riley. I am very grateful to Dr. Eileen McCarthy and her team.

Hello Heidi,

Thank you very much for your 5 star review❤️

I knew the time had come to say goodbye to our sweet Schwarzy, who had been battling lymphoma. 💔 He had been breathing heavily for the last several days, and as heartbreaking as it was, I knew it was time to let him go peacefully.
I called Ever After Veterinary Care, and they were able to see us that same day. Dr. Eileen and Marlee were so compassionate, gentle, and loving with my Schwarzy. They made an incredibly difficult moment a little more bearable.
I miss my little sweetheart more than words can say. ❤️🐾 I’m grateful he received the best care and was surrounded by love right up until the end.
Thank you, Ever After Veterinary Care, for treating Schwarzy with so much kindness and compassion. 🌈❤️

We had to put down our German Shepard and the doctors did such a great job making her comfortable at home. They took the time we needed to grieve and be with her in her last moments. Couldn’t recommend them enough! Thank you!

Eileen and Marley were incredibly compassionate. They talked through all of the steps of the process and were patient and understanding during their visit. I can't think of a better way to send my best friend off. Thank you!

This is the kind of veterinary service every pet owner hopes they never need but will always remember. Dr. Eileen and Marlee were gentle, respectful, and compassionate from the first phone call until they left our home. Having our dog peacefully pass surrounded by family was such a gift. If anyone is searching for mobile pet euthanasia or in-home euthanasia in Phoenix, Ever After Veterinary Care is the team to call.

I was skeptical to schedule our in-home euthanasia appointment with such a new practice that does not have as many reviews as some of the others, but I am so glad that I did. Dr. Eileen was absolutely fantastic. She was there for my family through every step of this incredibly difficult process. Both her and her assistant were incredibly kind, compassionate, and just good people. We have never experienced vet care like this before, it’s a shame that it was at the end of our sweet girl’s life. If you are on the fence about choosing Ever After, just know that you are in good hands!

After 14 years we had to make the decision to put our dog Toby to sleep. Dr. Eileen and her tech Marlee were extremely sympathetic and understanding throughout the entire process. They explained each step as they went and gave us an explanation on what might happen. Toby was a feisty one and known to bite a few fingers in his day but they were very gentle and careful with him to make sure he was comfortable. They went at our speed and ensured we got plenty of time to say our goodbyes and have our last moments with our boy. We were even given small vials of his fur as a keepsake. I could not have asked for a better experience doing such an awful thing.
Thank you for helping our Hendrix pass peacefully at home.

A few months have passed since my family said goodbye to our sweet golden retriever and I am now ready to share our story. Having used other in-home euthanasia companies in the past, I feel inclined to share the uniquely special experience I had with Dr. Eileen and Ever After Veterinary Care. I have unfortunately experienced many pets passing in my life, and this was by far the most peaceful and comforting process I could ever ask for. I truly did not know euthanizing a pet could be like this.

To be honest, Ever After was not the first business I reached out to when it was our sweet dog’s time to go. The two companies I had used previously did not have availability. I was a bit hesitant reaching out to Ever After due to them having less reviews and being a newer business, but I am so, so glad I did and feel that fate led me to them.

From the initial scheduling conversation where I spoke with Dr. Eileen, I felt as if she truly cared about my family and our dog’s situation. When she arrived at our home with her technician, Marlee, I was truly blown away by how much time Dr. Eileen spent discussing our girl’s quality of life, and the reasons why she felt that we were making the right decision at the right time for her.

Dr. Eileen allowed us to take as much time as we needed to process every step. After the euthanasia was performed, she even stepped out and allowed us time to process alone as a family. Her and Marlee were incredibly gentle and respectful towards our girl the entire process.

My family and I are so grateful that we stumbled upon Ever After Veterinary Care by chance, and I cannot recommend their services enough.

After searching through and calling around about a half dozen in-home euthanasia companies, I decided to go with Ever After Veterinary Care. I really was appreciative that you are able to speak with the doctor from the first phone call to go over any questions and concerns. The appointment went as well as it possibly could have given the circumstances. The doctor was incredibly compassionate, kind, and very skilled at her job. I highly recommend these guys if you are looking for in-home euthanasia for your pet.

What a truly outstanding service. From the first phone call you are able to speak to the doctor directly and have all of your questions answered. She was very kind, empathetic, and knowledgeable. I appreciated their honest pricing on their website and how they don’t throw a bunch of hidden fees in. When the doctor arrived with her technician, our sweet boy walked up to her and gave her a kiss. It was like he knew she was there to help him. Everything went much smoother than we expected, as our last in-home euthanasia experience with a different company in the valley was not quite what we were hoping for. I truly want to thank the Ever After team for everything.

I am so grateful that I found Dr. Eileen when searching for in-home euthanasia for our sweet boy Bruce. When I called, I was sobbing uncontrollably and was met with genuine empathy and understanding for my family’s situation. It was incredibly hard to make this decision, but I know in my heart that we did the kindest thing for our beloved family dog. Everything was incredibly peaceful, Dr. Eileen did a fantastic job explaining all of the steps, assuring us that Bruce was completely comfortable during the process, and her technician Marlee was great as well. Thank you so much for everything❤️

At a time that is very emotional, the care that I received from Dr. Eileen and Marlee was beyond what I had expected. From the moment they arrived til the moment they left helped me to understand the process. They allowed me as much time as I needed and never felt rushed. I can’t speak highly enough of this dynamic duo. Thank you Dr Eileen and Marlee for helping me through the loss of my special Trooper.

I don’t even know where to begin! Even though saying goodbye is so hard Dr.McCarthy made sure that I was comfortable throughout the entire appt, and ensured that I never once felt rushed or anything. In fact she made me feel like my girl and I were the most important people to her. Which just goes to show how truly passionate she is about providing pet parents the best possible care ever! 🫶🏽🥹

I contacted Dr.McCarthy 3 months ago to discuss this option as it is so hard to do, and she has shown me nothing short of compassion, patience, love, and kindness.🫶🏽(which we all need a little more of in our lives)

Needless to say I will 100% be going through Ever After Veterinary Care when the time comes to say goodbye to my other furbabies. I will recommend Ever After to anyone who is looking for a more comfortable home euthanasia for their furbabies! 🥹❤️

Again thank you so much to Dr.McCarthy and her tech Marlee - who helped keep my other furbaby ,who can’t help but want attention, distracted at times, and showed him some love while I said goodbye to my Princess❤️

Pictures of my sassy/spicy girl included! I hope you are running around again and getting all the cheese that you desire❤️

Saying goodbye to a furry family member is rough. When there is nothing left you can do the hard decision has to be made. The team at Ever After Veterinary Care helped make that decisions easier. The compassion, care and understanding they provide eases the ache that can’t be avoided. The ability to say goodbye in the comfort of our own home at the time we were ready made the hurt sting less. Thank you Ever After Veterinary Care for the service and comfort you provide.

So this is incredibly hard to write, but I feel compelled to let others know how wonderful of a company Ever After Veterinary Care is. Dr. Eileen is the one who answered my initial phone call. She was compassionate and showed genuine care for our situation and was able to accommodate a same-day appointment.

When Dr. Eileen and her tech arrived, we were at our lowest. I was crying, my husband was silent, and our toddler was wondering what was going on. Right away, we were comforted and assured that we were making the best decision for our boy. Dr. Eileen explained each step, let us ask any questions we had, and was so good with our daughter. She was able to explain what was happening in a toddler-friendly way, which we appreciated very much.

What started as the worst day of our lives honestly turned into a beautiful goodbye for our precious boy. He has not looked this peaceful in weeks. Once I saw all of his suffering ended, I realized that I in fact was not a terrible person for having to make this decision, but someone who granted the best gift possible for my best friend of 13 years.

I want to sincerely thank Ever After Veterinary Care for this experience. I didn’t know what in-home euthanasia would be like, but I’m relieved we chose this.

Ever After Veterinary Care exceeded every expectation. Dr. Eileen and her technician Marlee were compassionate, patient, and incredibly understanding throughout the entire process. They helped our senior dog pass peacefully at home surrounded by family. If you are searching for in-home pet euthanasia services in Phoenix, this team is truly exceptional.

We had to put down our family dog over this past weekend after our veterinarian told us it would be the kindest choice for him. Although it was an incredibly difficult decision to make, I am so so glad the we found Dr. McCarthy and the Ever After team. They were incredibly kind, compassionate, and showed genuine care for not only our sweet boy, but for our grieving process as well. Dr. Eileen answered all of our questions, explained each step as the process went along, and as weird as it sounds, the experience was quite peaceful and beautiful. I cannot recommend this company enough. Thank you so much for what you do❤️

Saying goodbye to my sweet Phoebe was the hardest thing I’ve ever had to do, but I am so thankful for the incredible at-home vet team who helped her cross the rainbow bridge. My normally anxious girl immediately sensed their gentle energy; she walked right up to them, ate treats from their hands, and settled peacefully on their blanket. They made a devastating day as gentle and comforting as possible, and the clay paw print they created is a treasure I’ll keep forever. I am endlessly grateful for the profound love and care they showed my baby.
They really took care of not only our beautiful boy but us in the hardest moment of our lives. Thank you.

Dr. McCarthy...
We had spent a good amount of time calling around to find in-home end of life care for our sweet boy, Apollo, when we found your contact information. We are so happy that we chose/found you. Your kindness, soft and caring demeanor, & the way you comforted Apollo during such a hard time is truly unforgettable. Our family was so heartbroken to have to make this decision and we were nervous to do the process in-home but your certainty and knowledge as well as the love you showed us from beginning to end of the process was what helped us along the way. Losing Apollo was/is one of the hardest things we've ever been through as a family but we thank you from the bottom of our hearts for supporting us, making this process peaceful, and for loving Apollo in the hours you spent with him in our home.
p.s. Received Apollo's ashes + paw print today from AquaCrossings and even a beautiful floral arrangement.... bitter sweet, but this was also beautifully done.
Thank you for everything...

Dr McCarthy and her tech were so incredibly patient, kind, empathetic and informative. They made the process of euthanizing my canine companion and best friend, Gertie, easier than I could have hoped for. The whole experience exceeded my expectations and I would highly recommend them to anyone who finds themselves in need.
You guys made this as easier than I could have ever imagined. Thank you for being there for my Beans.

As this is an extremely emotional decision to make, finding the right place is crucial!

I am newish to this area so thankfully when I searched our neighborhood community page for recommendations, I made the call and prayed it would be a good fit and timing would work.

And it did! Great customer service!! The most compassionate ladies (doctor and assistant), really felt like I had known them for a long time. They talked our family through every step of the way. Very kind and caring!

So hard to say goodbye to your fur baby. But when that time comes, call Ever After!

We were so grateful for Ever After Veterinary Care. They were so helpful in ensuring our beloved pup passed peacefully and with as much comfort as possible. We cannot thank you all enough for the kindness and compassion and ability to have the experience happen at home.
I’m so thankful for the kindness and compassion you showed us and our fur baby while he transitioned peacefully ♥️

I called Dr. Eileen at 5:00 pm on Saturday Night. My dog was in extremely critical condition and Was basically paralyzed in her back legs. There was no way I could lift her on my own and take her to ER because she weighs almost 80 Pounds. I called several other places and the soonest they could schedule me was on Monday. Savannah’s Condition was deteriorating quickly, and I decided there was no way I was going to make her wait until Monday. I just started dialing and Dr. Eileen was the first number I came upon and as I said it was 5 PM on Saturday night. She was at my door at 7 PM that same night with her anssistant and with loving care and understanding she gently assisted my Savannah was comfortably passing away. It was the hardest thing I have ever had to do in my life and the fact that she was there for me within a few hours having never met me before says everything to me. Both she and her assistant were extremely professional, and took time to examine my girl and explain Everything to me. She made this whole unbearable sad process A little easier. She is very good with communicating and responding quickly. If I could give her 10 stars, I would highly recommend Dr. Eileen.
This group was amazing with helping my dog make it to heaven. They were so compassionate- I couldn’t have asked for a better experience during such a traumatic time.

Ever After Veterinary Care is an incredibly professional, compassionate, and caring team. Every interaction reflects the respect, empathy, and dignity they bring to such an emotional and difficult time for families and their pets. Their attention to detail, calm presence, and genuine kindness truly set them apart. I would highly recommend Ever After to anyone looking for thoughtful, compassionate end-of-life care for their beloved pet.

I called them this morning (Saturday) and they were able to come out within a few hours so my pup didn't have to suffer.  They were wonderful and helped make the process easier though out was still tough.  You can tell they care about lot and I'm so thankful they were able to help so quick,  when many other places said they couldn't.

We used Ever After Veterinary Care for in-home pet euthanasia in Phoenix, and I can’t recommend them enough. Dr. McCarthy was incredibly compassionate, patient, and respectful during one of the hardest moments of our lives.

Having at-home euthanasia allowed our dog to pass peacefully and comfortably, surrounded by family. Although this was one of the hardest decisions we’ve ever had to make, we are extremely grateful for this experience. If you’re looking for kind, professional, in-home pet euthanasia services in the Phoenix area, this team truly cares.

My 17 year old cat had kidney disease.  His health and quality of life declined significantly in the past two weeks. I had to make this difficult decision. I think it's easier on everyone when you're at home.

This is my beautiful kitty in his youth.

Dr. McCarthy was extremely helpful and compassionate. She took the time to listen and showed true empathy for both us and our dog. She thoughtfully explained possible causes of our dog’s behavioral issues and provided multiple options instead of rushing us into behavioral euthanasia. We felt supported, understood, and never judged. She kindly told us to reach out if we need her for anything. Highly recommend <3

When my dog was just a tiny puppy, Dr. McCarthy was the veterinary technician who helped care for him. She was patient, calm, and genuinely kind in moments when I was scared and overwhelmed. Even back then, it was obvious that this wasn’t “just a job” for her. She treated him like he mattered.

Years later, when the hardest day finally came, it felt almost unreal that it was Dr. McCarthy again, this time as a doctor who helped guide us through saying goodbye.

Having the same person who helped care for my puppy at the beginning of his life be the one to compassionately put him to rest was incredibly meaningful. Dr. McCarthy gave us the most peaceful, loving goodbye we could have hoped for. She explained everything, never rushed us, and held space for our grief with so much empathy and respect.

Losing a pet is devastating, but knowing he was in the hands of someone who had known him from the start brought a level of comfort I can’t fully put into words.

If you are looking for a veterinarian who treats your pet like family and honors the bond you share, I cannot recommend Dr. McCarthy and her services highly enough. She walked with us through the very first chapter and the last, and for that, we will always be grateful.

Our animals become our family and when the difficult decision is made to say goodbye, it’s utterly heartbreaking. We do not forget them, they will always be in our memories, but how we say goodbye can weigh heavy on our heart. Years ago, I was left heartbroken and traumatized because I was not able to peacefully say goodbye to my dog. He had cancer and it should have been a more peaceful ending, but we ended up in an emergency veterinarian office.

Years later, I had to make the difficult decision to say goodbye to my other dog, Banjo, and I vowed to make the experience as peaceful as I could. Dr. McCarthy helped guide my family in giving Banjo the best quality of life until his last breath. “His last day doesn’t have to be a bad day.” We lived by this phrase Dr. McCarthy shared, and spent the weekend spoiling and doing everything Banjo loved. Dr. McCarthy has a special gift, you can feel her empathy and love without her saying a word. Her passion for animals shows in her approach and kindness.

Because of Dr. McCarthy we were able to say goodbye to our sweet boy in the comfort of our home, in our favorite chair, in my arms. His last breath was peaceful, I know he wasn’t scared or traumatized, he was loved. Thank you Dr. McCarthy, thank you for sharing your special gift, and for filling our room with even more love during a difficult time.

My fiancé and I called around multiple mobile euthanasia practices until we finally found the one we connected with. Dr. McCarthy was able to schedule us for the same day and we cannot thank her for making this incredibly hard decision easier to navigate. We discussed our pets quality of life and a realistic outcome if we decided not to proceed with euthanasia, and we just could not see him suffer any longer. The whole team was extremely caring and gentle throughout this entire process. I am writing this review not only to help out the practice, but to help other families make informed decisions on who to trust. Thank you so much for all that you do!

Our sweet boy Simba experienced a couple of urinary blockages, and we ultimately had to make the incredibly difficult decision to let him go. We’re so grateful to Dr. Eileen and her team for making his final moments so loving and peaceful. Being able to say goodbye to him at home meant the world to us, and we can’t thank them enough for the compassion and comfort they gave during such a hard time.

Thank you, Megan. We’re glad our pricing felt fair and accessible. Providing compassionate in-home care at a reasonable cost is important to us, and we appreciate you taking a moment to share your feedback.

This is a review I never thought I would have to make and I’m getting emotional just typing this, but the team at Ever After has been so incredible throughout this whole grieving process that I want everyone who has to go through the pain of putting their pet down to get the help that we had.

From the initial call, Dr. McCarthy answered all of our questions, was extremely empathetic, and was nothing less than great.

The euthanasia itself went a lot better than we could have imagined. Although my whole family was extremely sad, there was a sense of peace and our little dog Bingo looked extremely comfortable and calm the entire time. We were able to put him down in our backyard under his favorite shade tree and with everyone that loved him surrounding him.

I could not imagine having to do this process inside of a Vet office with other animals barking, hearing people laugh and talk, and just feeling so clinical. We are so extremely grateful for Dr. McCarthy and her techs. I would highly recommend them to everyone who needs to make this difficult decision!

Thank you so much❤️

We scheduled a consultation because we thought it might be time to say goodbye to our senior cat, Milo. From the moment we spoke with Ever After Veterinary Care, they were kind, honest, and patient. When the doctor met Milo and evaluated him, she gently explained that he was still comfortable and had more good days ahead.
I was shocked, honestly. Most companies would have gone through with it without question. Instead, they gave us peace of mind, guidance for his ongoing care, and refused to rush us into a decision. It’s clear they genuinely care about animals and families, not money.
I can’t express how relieved and grateful we are to have found a team with such integrity and compassion.

We recently had to say goodbye to our sweet Lulu & Ever After Veterinary Care was absolutely incredible. They made such a heartbreaking day feel peaceful. From the moment they arrived, they were so kind, patient, and empathetic — it honestly felt like they truly cared about Lulu and our whole family. They explained everything to us so gently and took the time to talk to our kids in such a comforting way which was one of the hardest

It never once felt rushed or clinical — just genuine compassion and care. They gave us the time we needed, treated Lulu with so much love, and helped us say goodbye in the most peaceful way possible. I can’t say enough good things about them. We’re so thankful for how they handled everything and would recommend Ever After Veterinary Care to anyone facing this kind of loss. They helped make something so hard feel a little more bearable!

After calling around to multiple mobile euthanasia clinics, we landed on Ever After. They were the first to express empathy towards our situation, asked questions about our dog’s quality of life, and just lent us their ear as we expressed our emotions. Not once did this feel like a transactional relationship, just a doctor that truly cares about treating animals with respect and helping owners during the grieving process.

Dr. McCarthy did an excellent job in making our boy Maverick feel completely at ease throughout the whole process. What felt like was going to be the worst day of our lives was actually incredibly endearing and a beautiful send off for our boy. Of course we will always miss him, but we know we made the right decision.

Thank you so much for what you do❤️

We were told at our vets office that there was not much we could do for our family dog except keep him comfy until he passes or euthanize but didn’t want to do it at the vet office so we looked online and found Ever After. Dr. McCarthy and her team were able to do a consultation and schedule us for the next day. They were extremely kind, compassionate and made this process as easy as can be. Dr. McCarthy explained each step of the euthanasia process and answered all of our questions. I highly recommend them if you ever have to make this decision for your pet because the overall experience is night and day compared to doing this service in an office. Although we are devastated that we lost our best friend, we are happy that we were able to send him over the rainbow bridge in the place he loved to be surrounded by all of us.

Their team is absolutely amazing. They helped us through one of the hardest days when our pet’s quality of life had come to an end. They were so kind, caring, and respectful through the entire process. The way they handled everything made a really tough situation feel peaceful and full of love.

Dr. McCarthy and team did the unimaginable for us when our dog was no longer fit for a good life in the most loving, caring and professional way that brought dignity to our dog’s life all the way to the end. Their commemorative tokens of remembrance they gave, alongside their condolences to our family, felt like a world class service. I would highly consider them helping you through your difficult time as they did so well for us. Thank you EAVC, we could not have had it any better with your care given the unfortunate circumstances of our dog.

I didn’t know what to expect going into this process, but we are extremely lucky to have found Ever After. This was the first time we felt a sense of true compassion for our dog. Although we are so sad to leave behind our best friend Bandit, he was at peace and got to have some chocolate before he was put to sleep. Thank you so much!

Dr. McCarthy and the Ever After team have been nothing less than great throughout this whole process. We had no idea where to begin or if at home euthanasia was even an option until we stumbled across them on Google. From the initial conversation, we knew we made the right choice for our family as they handled everything with compassion and excellent care. I can’t recommend their service enough as they truly made such a difficult decision a warm and endearing moment for us.
